summary: Ran public API regression checks and mobile web smoke flow. Seed shape, missing-token handling, and clearance payment-request transition passed; welcome and agency screens rendered. The browser run was interrupted by a test-side seeded-state mutation, which was restored.

minor.issue: Endpoint clears any awaiting milestone; no sequential prerequisite check is enforced.
Acceptance stores scope_accepted_at on the engagement, but no separate immutable audit record is persisted.

integration_issues.issue: Backend request-change endpoint exists, but client milestone detail has no request-change control or note input, so the required flow is not reachable from UI.

action_items: Add client request-change note UI wired to POST request-change.
Enforce sequential milestone clearance in backend and expose the error state in the client UI.
Persist an immutable scope acceptance audit event if the audit-record requirement is distinct from the engagement timestamp.
Avoid mutating the seeded demo record in regression tests; use an isolated test engagement fixture.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend only implements agency sample navigation; authenticated engagement listing/create flow remains backlog functionality.
Google OAuth web redirect and session exchange contract is implemented, but cannot be validated without an evaluator Google account.

success_rate.frontend: 50% (welcome/agency passed; client portal flow not completed due test state assertion)

seed_data_creation: No seed data created. The existing sample milestone temporarily changed during testing and was restored to its original state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env. Sample token is checkpoint-demo. Do not clear sample milestones in tests unless restoring state afterward.
rca_of_issue: The client request-change requirement is incomplete at the integration layer: server.py exposes request_change, but index.tsx has no request-change handler, note field, or button. Sequential progression is also absent because clear_milestone only checks engagement active status and directly marks the requested milestone cleared.
